results.name: S4 does not fetch the approved image on plain page load (data-gated by real design, not a bug)
First visit: clicking a section deterministically loads the approved image (no fixed sleep required)
Refresh: clicking the section again loads the approved image
Back-and-return: the section click still loads the approved image
Repeated click on an already-viewed section still resolves the image (cache-served is fine)
The rendered element actually loaded (complete, non-zero width) — no blank/broken image
A slow (800ms) response still resolves within the bounded 3s wait, not stalling indefinitely
